Compact elongated grains produce thermal polarization following the direction along the projected long axis when $\lambda$ is much larger than grain size $a$, or more specifically when $\lambda > 2 \pi a$ (Rayleigh regime).
However, when $\lambda$ is comparable to $2 \pi a$ (Mie regime), the (thermal) polarization direction can flip, i.e., change by $90^{\circ}$, and become perpendicular to the projected long axis
